# White Glove Itineraries

> White Glove Itineraries is a travel itinerary and trip-management website for travellers and travel advisers. Build day-by-day itineraries, organise travel details and carry a shared itinerary in the companion app.

Official website: https://www.whitegloveitineraries.com/
Contact: contact@whitegloveitineraries.com

## When to use this site

Use White Glove Itineraries when someone wants to understand a day-by-day travel itinerary, organise their own travel details, see how a trip companion works, or evaluate tools for managing client itineraries. Start with the homepage and About page; use the fictional Rome sample to explain the itinerary, app and print views. Read Pricing for current access information and Contact for enquiries.

Read these public pages with ordinary HTTPS GET requests; no API key or account is needed for product research. Request the homepage with Accept: text/markdown for this compact guide, or Accept: text/html for the website. Existing users log in through the website to work on their trips. Account creation, bookings and private trip operations are not public crawler APIs.

## Public information

- [Home](https://www.whitegloveitineraries.com/): Product overview and ways to explore the website.
- [About](https://www.whitegloveitineraries.com/about): What White Glove Itineraries does.
- [Sample itinerary](https://www.whitegloveitineraries.com/sample-itinerary): An illustrative trip for a fictional family in Rome, with day-by-day, companion-app and printed views. This is a sample, not a reservation or an actual customer's trip.
- [Pricing and access](https://www.whitegloveitineraries.com/pricing): Current plan and availability information. New accounts require an invitation; existing account holders can log in. Purchases are currently unavailable.
- [Contact](https://www.whitegloveitineraries.com/contact): Contact information and enquiries.
- [Privacy](https://www.whitegloveitineraries.com/privacy): Personal information, device-only travel wallet files, shared attachments and trip conversations.
- [Terms](https://www.whitegloveitineraries.com/terms): Terms for using the website.
- [Sitemap](https://www.whitegloveitineraries.com/sitemap.xml): Public pages available for discovery.

## Product details

An itinerary can bring flights, accommodation, transport, activities, maps, schedules, notes and contacts together. The traveller companion opens a particular shared trip using its trip code. It provides itinerary viewing, a personal travel wallet and conversations with that trip's travel group.

Personal wallet documents are stored on the traveller's device, with offline document viewing. They are not cloud-synced or automatically shared with the group. Shared itinerary attachments have separate access permissions.

## Public and private access

Public information pages are readable without an account or JavaScript. The public sample is fictional. Customer itineraries, trip-code links, travel documents, group conversations, invitations, accounts and administration are private access flows and are excluded from crawler discovery. A shared-trip link grants access to that trip; it is not a public listing.

The site's robots.txt describes crawler exclusions. Those exclusions do not replace server-side access controls. Crawlers have the same access requirements as people; a crawler user-agent does not bypass authentication or trip-code checks.
